description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F108126
Sheriff’s File # 26002100
PLAINTIFF – Windstream Capital, LLC vs:
DEFENDANTS- Helen E. Bennett, deceased, her unknown heirs, devisees and personal representatives and his, her, their or any of their successors in right, title and interest, et als
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 7th day of December 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Freehold, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Tax Lot: 2.04 Block: 86 Located on the tax map of the Township of Freehold
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
103 Gravel Hill Road Freehold, NJ 07728
Dimensions: Being known as Lot No. 5, as shown on a map entitled, "Subdivision Map of Property, situated in Freehold Township, Monmouth County, N.J.", prepared for Natalie Lewinger by Jersey Engineering Co., Professional Engineers and Surveyors Long Branch, New Jersey, dated July 3,1961 and revised August 15, 1961, Scale: 1'-100' which said map was filed in the Monmouth County Clerk's office on December 18, 1961 in case No.25, Sheet No. 30, and approved by the Planning Board of Freehold Township on November 24, 1961 and was approved by Resolution of the Township Committee on December 13, 1961.
No. of Feet to the Nearest Cross Street: approximately 150 feet from interest with Dancer Lane
Good Faith Upset Bid $530,000.00
The Occupancy Status of the property is: VACANT
**Subject to Special Changes due Freehold Township as of 9-30-2026 of $1,111.61
This sale is also further subject to possessory rights of any tenant or party residing in the property.
All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $887,498.13.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: October 14, 2026
Dembo Brown & Burns LLP

suite 205
Mount Laurel, NJ 08054
